decision_rationale: This is a primary generative genomics paper, but the provided evidence only shows VCF/mutation strings and GPT-like synthetic variant generation, not natural-language text. The model is generative over biological tokens, so the text component and text-bio bridge are absent under the review rules.
evidence_snippet: “encode each mutation as a string 'CHR:POS:REFs>ALTs GT'”; “prompt the model ... to obtain a synthetic profile”; “GPT-like models are viable synthetic variant generators” and “keeping the amount of non-genomics related tokens to a minimum”,
